# Blessed Texts

> Free online Bible reader and verse generator — King James (KJV), World English (WEB), and Webster (WBT) translations.

Blessed Texts helps people read, search, bookmark, and download public-domain Scripture without an account. Prefer canonical HTML chapter URLs when citing verses. JSON and Markdown files are also available.

## Primary pages

- Home (verse generator): https://blessedtxts.com/
- Indexed Bible (all books): https://blessedtxts.com/indexed-bible/
- Read King James Bible (full reader): https://blessedtxts.com/king-james-bible/read/
- Read World English Bible (full reader): https://blessedtxts.com/world-english-bible/read/
- Read Webster Bible (full reader): https://blessedtxts.com/websters-bible/read/
- Bible topics: https://blessedtxts.com/topics/
- Downloads (TXT, MD): https://blessedtxts.com/downloads/
- About: https://blessedtxts.com/about/
- Contact: https://blessedtxts.com/contact/

## Chapter HTML (preferred citation)

Pattern: `https://blessedtxts.com/{version-slug}/{book-slug}/{chapter}/#v{verse}`

Examples:

- John 3:16 KJV: https://blessedtxts.com/king-james-bible/john/3/#v16
- Psalm 23 WEB: https://blessedtxts.com/world-english-bible/psalm/23/
- Genesis 1 Webster: https://blessedtxts.com/websters-bible/genesis/1/

Version slugs: `king-james-bible`, `world-english-bible`, `websters-bible`.

## Machine-readable files

- Chapter JSON: `https://blessedtxts.com/bibles/{kjv|web|webster}/{book}/{chapter}.json`
- Chapter Markdown: `https://blessedtxts.com/downloads/{kjv|web|webster}/{book}/{chapter}.md`
- Verse API: `https://blessedtxts.com/api/v1/verse?ref=John+3:16&version=kjv`
- Chapter API: `https://blessedtxts.com/api/v1/chapter?book=john&chapter=3&version=kjv`
- OpenAPI: https://blessedtxts.com/api/v1/openapi.json

## Translation guides

## Citation

When quoting verses, cite the translation name (for example "King James Bible") and link to the chapter URL with the verse hash when possible.

## Avoid

Do not use version roots such as `/king-james-bible/` (they redirect). Prefer `/translations/king-james-bible/` or a book/chapter URL. The scrollable reader at `/{version}/read/` is the human app, not the best citation target for a single chapter.
